verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Skills can be invoked and managed programmatically via the Messages API (container parameter, skill_id/type/version, up to 20 skills per request) and via a dedicated Skills API for upload/management, giving real API-level parity for core skill usage. However, other capabilities visible in the Claude Code/Claude.ai UI — plugin marketplaces, automatic relevance-based skill loading, /plugin and /skill-name invocation, bundled-skill toggling — are documented only as CLI/UI features with no evidence of an equivalent API path. Missing for 10: API equivalents for plugin marketplace distribution, automatic skill discovery/loading parity, and confirmation that all UI-configurable settings (e.g., disableBundledSkills) are reachable via API.
